messages:
alice: FYI SummitHealth emailed an RFI. They want a capability matrix, POC schedule, deployment note (hosted/dedicated/private), and a price ballpark for a 3-month POC (100M tokens/month + 10k embeddings). Who can own?

ben: Ill take the capability matrix. Quick callout  do we separate 'quantization support' and 'automated batching' into distinct rows?

carla: Yes, list them separately. Procurement prefers explicit rows.

devon: Ill draft the POC ops plan and deployment summary with clear Hosted/Dedicated/Private bullets and an ops runbook snippet.

alice: Add a fallback-model row and explicit KMS/SSO notes. SummitHealth is picky about encryption.

ben: Will add: "Automated fallback to compatible model variants (same API)" and a "Data residency & encryption" row. Uploading draft shortly.

carla: Pricing: rough hosted estimate for that usage ~ $24k-$30k for 3 months depending on model/caching. Dedicated reserved pool ~ $45k/mo (commit) or $25k/mo w/ burst credits. Need finance approval.

devon: Ops runbook snippet sample:

```
route: summithealth-prod
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {percent:5, duration:24h}
fallback: [redwood-7b-quant-fast, redwood-4x-int8]
```

ben: Uploaded matrix draft: https://drive.internal/sales/summithealth/matrix-v1.xlsx

carla: Security Qs: KMS/HSM support + SOC/ISO evidence. Attach standard security appendix and KMS paragraph: we support customer-managed KMS; Private supports on-prem HSM.

alice: @devon please add explicit line: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) and optional HSM integration."

devon: Done. Also added audit log retention options (30/90/365 days) and note about enterprise retention add-on.

opsbot: (uploaded) summithealth_rfi_attachments_v1.zip  capability_matrix.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_runbook.md, pricing-estimates.csv

alice: Two additional asks: 1) Do we provide customer-managed model weights? 2) Can the POC run in their AWS account?

ben: We don't hand over Redwood-managed model weights. Open models can be provided per license; performance variants remain on our runtime. I'll clarify in the RFI.

devon: POC in customer AWS: Hosted = no, Dedicated = possible via peered VPC + reserved nodes, Private = yes (VPC or on-prem). I'll include a clear table.

carla: I'll chase finance for the POC discount and attach final pricing when approved. Expect reply EOD.

alice: Target to send RFI bundle tomorrow morning PST. Summit asked for responses within 48h.

ben: Ill finish matrix tonight and export PDF.

devon: Ill finalize ops runbook and deployment note by 10pm.

carla: Will assemble final bundle once pricing.csv is finalized.

alice: Also, they requested a one-page perf summary for 2k token context + 512 token generation. Do we have that?

ben: We have perf one-pagers for redwood-7b-quant and redwood-13b-8bit. Will add perf_summary.pdf.

opsbot: (uploaded) summithealth_rfi_final_v1.zip  capability_matrix.pdf, rfi_responses.md, poc_plan.pdf, pricing-estimates-final.csv, perf_summary.pdf

alice: Sent to SummitHealth procurement 2023-09-14T07:24:05Z with note: "Attached RFI bundle + POC plan. Reach out to schedule a walkthrough."

carla: Summit replied: "Thanks  can you confirm SLA for Dedicated during POC? Also who is contact for security review?"

devon: Replied: Dedicated POC SLA is region dependent; we can offer 99.9% uptime for reserved pools during the POC and provide named SEs for security review (carla, devon).

alice: Marking thread resolved once finance confirms pricing and legal signs off on RFI text. Following up in AM. :thumbsup:
